@graph.name: Formester Free Form Builder
@graph.description: Free embeddable form builder with six embed modes: inline, popup, sidebar, side tab, popover, fullscreen. Works on WordPress, Webflow, Wix, Squarespace, GoDaddy, and plain HTML.

mainEntity.name: Is the embed code really free to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Build the form on the free plan, copy the snippet, paste it on your site. No usage cap on the embed itself, and no cap on forms or responses.

mainEntity.name: Will the embedded form display Powered by Formester?

acceptedAnswer.text: A small Formester credit shows on forms on the free plan. The Personal plan at $12 a month removes it across every form and every embed mode.

mainEntity.name: Can I embed multiple forms on one page?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Each form has its own snippet, you can paste as many as you need on the same page without conflicts.

mainEntity.name: Does the embed work on mobile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every embed mode is mobile responsive by default. The form adapts to the screen size of the device, including the popup, side tab, and fullscreen modes.

mainEntity.name: Will the form match my site's styles?

acceptedAnswer.text: You control the colors, fonts, button styles, and spacing inside Formester. Custom CSS is available if you want to match a specific design system. The form keeps its own styles inside the embed so it does not collide with your site's CSS.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to host anything?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The form is hosted by Formester. The snippet you paste just loads it on your page. No server, no database, no maintenance on your end.

mainEntity.name: How is this different from Google Forms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Google Forms embeds only as a plain iframe, with Google styling and a Powered by Google line you cannot remove. Formester ships six embed modes, lets you brand and style the form, and adds payment collection, file uploads, signatures, and analytics on the free plan.

mainEntity.name: Can I migrate later if I outgrow the free plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every form, every submission, every integration stays on the same account when you upgrade. The embed code on your site keeps working without changes, the new plan limits apply from the moment you upgrade.

@graph.name: How to embed a Formester form on any website

step.name: Build the form in Formester
step.text: Start with a template or paste a prompt into the AI form generator. Edit fields, labels, and conditional logic in the drag-and-drop builder.

step.name: Copy the embed snippet
step.text: Open Share, choose Embed. Pick inline, popup, side tab, sidebar, popover, or fullscreen. Copy the one-line snippet.

step.name: Paste into your site's HTML block
step.text: On WordPress add a Custom HTML block, on Webflow drop an Embed element, on Wix add an Embed Code element, on Squarespace add a Code Block, or paste anywhere between the body tags in plain HTML.

Six embed modes, one for every spot on your site

A contact form belongs inline on the page. A newsletter belongs in a popup. A feedback prompt belongs in a side tab that stays out of the way. Formester ships all six so you do not have to pick a different tool for each job.

INLINE FORM
Drops into the page
Inline

Drops into the page like any other block

Renders inline where the snippet sits. Keeps its own styles inside the embed.

Best for: contact, applications, signup blocks
POPUP
Opens over the page
Popup

Opens over the page on click or after a delay

Trigger on click, scroll depth, time, or exit intent. Dimmed overlay behind.

Best for: lead magnets, exit intent, gated downloads
FEEDBACK
Side tab

Anchored tab on the side, opens on click

Pinned to the page edge. Stays out of the reading flow until tapped.

Best for: always-on feedback, support requests
SIDEBAR
Slides in
Sidebar

Slides in from the edge of the screen

Animated drawer from left or right. Leaves the page visible behind it.

Best for: beta signups, event RSVPs
POPOVER
Floating card
Popover

Small floating card that pulls attention

Smaller than a popup. No overlay. Anchored to a button or page corner.

Best for: onboarding nudges, one-question polls
FULLSCREEN
Takes over viewport
Fullscreen

Takes over the full viewport when triggered

Immersive mode. One question at a time, like a survey landing page.

Best for: survey landings, NPS asks, course intakes

Every mode uses the same embed snippet. Switch modes from the dashboard, the live form on your site updates without you touching the code again.

Embed on your site in 3 minutes, on any CMS

Build the form, grab the snippet, paste it where you want it to appear. Hit publish. Done.
